{"id":1988235358,"question_id":4282,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1777172046,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"22 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1988235358/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Sort Vowels by Frequency","memory":"18.4 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    unordered_map<char,int>freq;\n    unordered_map<char,int>pos;\n\n    string sortVowels(string s) {\n        int n = s.size();\n        \n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++){\n            if(s[i] == 'a' or s[i] == 'e' or s[i] == 'i' or s[i] == 'o' or s[i] == 'u'){\n                freq[s[i]]++;\n                if(!pos.count(s[i])) pos[s[i]] = i;\n            }      \n        }\n\n        vector<char>vowels = {'a' , 'e' , 'i' , 'o' , 'u'};\n        sort(vowels.begin() , vowels.end() , [&](char &a , char &b)\n         {\n            if(freq[a] != freq[b]) return freq[a] > freq[b];\n            return pos[a] < pos[b];\n         });\n\n        string temp = \"\";\n        for(auto it : vowels) for(int i = 0 ; i<freq[it] ; i++) temp += it;\n                                  \n        int idx = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++){\n            if(s[i] == 'a' or s[i] == 'e' or s[i] == 'i' or s[i] == 'o' or s[i] == 'u')\n                s[i] = temp[idx++];\n        }\n        return s;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"sort-vowels-by-frequency","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1943}
